title: Direct coupling of Ras to preformed maleimide-functionalized lipid membranes
protocol: Prepare a maleimide lipid-containing phospholipid mix in chloroform.
Dry the lipids to a thin film under nitrogen or argon gas.
Remove residual chloroform by drying under vacuum for about 1 hour.
Hydrate dried films with degassed buffer to a total lipid concentration of 2–10 mg/ml.
Raise suspension into solution by freezing and thawing cycles.
Form unilamellar vesicles by passing the suspension through a high pressure extruder with a 100 nm diameter pore filter at least ten times.
Mix approximately 1 Ras with 4 maleimide-lipids (~0.07 µmoles Ras: 0.25 µmoles maleimide-lipid).
Incubate the mixture under argon at room temperature for two hours.
Continue incubation at 4°C overnight.
Add 5 mM ß-mercaptoethanol to terminate reactions and quench excess maleimide-lipid.
Incubate the reaction at room temperature for at least 10 minutes.

Separate unmodified Ras proteins from Ras-coupled lipid vesicles by size-exclusion chromatography using an XK-16 column (GE Healthcare) containing about 30 ml of Sepharose CL-4B resin equilibrated in gel filtration buffer.
Determine the lipid concentration after Ras-conjugation using TR-DHPE absorbance at Abs590.
Measure the absorbance (Abs590) of both ‘stock’ maleimide-functionalized vesicles before and after Ras-conjugation to find the “dilution factor” of the vesicles.
Perform a Bradford assay on both ‘stock’ maleimide-functionalized vesicles (no Ras proteins present) and Ras-coupled vesicles.
Calculate the contribution of lipids to the Bradford reagent signal using the dilution factor from the TR-DHPE absorbance at 590 nm.
Determine the signal corresponding to Ras by subtracting the lipid signal from the total signal in Ras-coupled vesicles.
Prepare solutions of equal Ras concentration by volume for SDS-PAGE gel analysis.
Compare the prepared Ras solutions to Ras protein standards on the SDS-PAGE gel.
Soak wells of a glass-bottomed 96-well plate with 6 M NaOH to clean the surface.
Incubate the wells for 2 hours.
Wash the wells with 10 ml distilled/deionized H₂O using a pipette and aspirator.
Bring the volume in each well to approximately 100 µl by filling to maximum capacity (400 µl) and removing an appropriate volume.
Add 50 µl of maleimide-functionalized vesicles diluted with an equal volume of 250 mM TRIS-HCl pH 7.4, 1 M NaCl to each well.
Incubate the wells for 10 minutes.
Wash each well with at least 5 ml of 25 mM TRIS-HCl pH 7.4, 100 mM NaCl.
Incubate wells for 10 minutes in 0.1% (w/v) BSA in 25 mM TRIS-HCl pH 7.4, 100 mM NaCl.
Inspect supported bilayer quality by microscopy and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching \(FRAP).
Bring the volume in each well to 50 μl.
Add 100 μl of Ras at about 8 mg/ml in 25 mM TRIS-HCl pH 7.4, 100 mM NaCl to each well.
Incubate the wells at room temperature for at least 20 minutes.
Incubate the plate overnight in the refrigerator with the plate covered.
